Loads from the Cities of Capitola, Santa Cruz, Watsonville, and outside Santa Cruz
County are subject to a 28% surcharge.

TREATED WOOD WASTE (TWW): Must be declared and documented.
Charged at the garbage rate. See the summarized TWW policy in this
document and visit SantaCruzCountyRecycles.org for more information.

SPECIAL HANDLE REFUSE: Includes agricultural plastics, large
non-recyclable metal items, rancid waste, dead animals, waste requiring
supervised burial, and any other materials designated by facility staff.
Not accepted at the Ben Lomond Transfer Station. The Special Handle
rate also applies to wood waste loads containing dirt, refuse, pieces over
8 feet long or 4 feet in diameter, or any materials not allowed under the
Wood Waste and Yard Waste Acceptance Policy.

CONTAMINATED / NON-COMPLIANT GARBAGE, REFUSE AND TRASH:
Garbage loads containing sortable recyclable materials that are
disposed of in the garbage and contain more than 5% recyclable
material in violation of County Recycling Ordinance, as determined by
County staff.

CLEAN SORTED WOOD WASTE & YARDWASTE: No refuse, dirt, treated or
painted lumber, poison oak, pampas grass, bamboo, yucca, palm, root
balls, or materials over 8 ft. length x 2 ft. diameter, 4 ft. length x 3 ft.
diameter, or 2 ft. length x 4 ft. diameter.

TIRES: Waste tire hauler certification and manifest are required for
disposal of nine (9) or more tires. The CalRecycle California Uniform
Waste and Used Tire Manifest tracks generation, transportation, and final
disposal of used/waste tires in California.

Mobile homes, trailers, cars, boats,
motorcycles, and other VIN-bearing
vehicles or vessels are not accepted for
recycling or disposal.

Do not bring VIN-bearing items to
the landfill or transfer station.

If the scale or computer system is
inoperable, all vehicles will be charged by
cubic yard (CY).

CY charges apply until normal scale
operations resume.

Items larger than 8 feet long or 8 inches in
diameter are not accepted.

Sortable loads with scrap metal, pipe, lumber,
wood waste, yard waste, stumps, or logs are
not accepted in the refuse area.

Separate materials before arrival and
use the proper recycling area.

Declare TWW at the Scale House. County staff will weigh the load and collect
required customer/load information per DTSC requirements.

No material charge for eligible
products; $35 minimum may apply.

Quantity/container limits apply; use
PaintCare retail take-back sites.
